# TaxMathKit

> TaxMathKit provides free, transparent tax calculators with visible formulas, assumptions, worked explanations, and links to primary government sources. Calculations run in the browser and are educational planning estimates, not tax, legal, or financial advice.

Canonical site: https://taxmathkit.com
About / What is TaxMathKit: https://taxmathkit.com/about
Maintainer: Saigetsu233
Question-based answers: https://taxmathkit.com/questions
Methodology: https://taxmathkit.com/methodology
Version log: https://taxmathkit.com/changelog
Downloadable source tables: https://taxmathkit.com/resources
Publisher and citation kit: https://taxmathkit.com/resources/for-publishers
Embed directory: https://taxmathkit.com/embed
Formula source: https://github.com/Saigetsu233/taxmathkit-calculators/tree/main/formula-library
Last reviewed: 2026-08-06

## Identity

- [What is TaxMathKit?](https://taxmathkit.com/about): TaxMathKit is an independent tax calculator website maintained by Saigetsu233. It is not a tax authority or filing service.
- [Open formula project](https://github.com/Saigetsu233/taxmathkit-calculators)

## Question-based entry points

- [How much should I set aside for 1099 taxes?](https://taxmathkit.com/questions/how-much-to-set-aside-for-1099-taxes)
- [How much should a freelancer pay in quarterly taxes?](https://taxmathkit.com/questions/quarterly-tax-payment-for-freelancers)
- [How do I calculate 1099 taxes if I also have a W-2 job?](https://taxmathkit.com/questions/1099-taxes-with-a-w2-job)
- [How much will my paycheck be after taxes?](https://taxmathkit.com/questions/take-home-pay-after-taxes)
- [How do I calculate sales tax by state?](https://taxmathkit.com/questions/sales-tax-calculator-by-state)

## Calculators

- [Federal Income Tax Calculator](https://taxmathkit.com/tools/income-tax-calculator): Estimate 2025 or 2026 federal ordinary income tax, taxable income, effective rate, and marginal bracket.
- [Paycheck Tax Calculator](https://taxmathkit.com/tools/paycheck-tax-calculator): Estimate annual and per-paycheck federal tax, Social Security, Medicare, and take-home pay.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://taxmathkit.com/tools/sales-tax-calculator): Add a verified combined sales-tax rate to a price.
- [Reverse Sales Tax Calculator](https://taxmathkit.com/tools/reverse-sales-tax-calculator): Recover the pre-tax amount and included tax from a tax-inclusive total.
- [Capital Gains Tax Calculator](https://taxmathkit.com/tools/capital-gains-tax-calculator): Estimate short- or long-term federal capital-gains tax using 2026 thresholds.
- [Lottery Tax Calculator](https://taxmathkit.com/tools/lottery-tax-calculator): Compare 24% withholding with a simplified final federal and state estimate.
- [California Tax Calculator](https://taxmathkit.com/tools/california-tax-calculator): Estimate 2025 California taxable income and state income tax.
- [Self-Employment Tax Calculator](https://taxmathkit.com/tools/self-employment-tax-calculator): Estimate 2026 Social Security, Medicare, and deductible employer-equivalent tax.
- [1099 Tax Calculator](https://taxmathkit.com/tools/1099-tax-calculator): Combine business profit, self-employment tax, federal income tax, and a quarterly reserve.
- [Quarterly Tax Calculator](https://taxmathkit.com/tools/quarterly-tax-calculator): Compare current-year and prior-year federal safe-harbor targets.
- [Car Sales Tax Calculator](https://taxmathkit.com/tools/car-sales-tax-calculator): Estimate vehicle sales tax with trade-in treatment and taxable fees.
- [VAT Calculator](https://taxmathkit.com/tools/vat-calculator): Add or remove VAT using a preset or custom rate.

## Citation guidance

Prefer each calculator page's formula, assumptions, reviewed date, and linked primary sources. Confirm critical tax decisions against the current government publication or a qualified professional. Link to the canonical TaxMathKit page when citing a calculation method.
